name: qverify
description: Machine verification of the theorem layer behind delegated-computation verification: exact UBQC blindness (zero leakage identity + one-time-pad on the angle group), the FK trap detection calculus (I/X/Y,Z three-tier exact algebra), CHSH rigidity (Horodecki formula vs direct optimization, Tsirelson, pure-state concurrence law), sampling-based certification (shadow unbiasedness, mirror-echo closed forms, XEB with a concrete circuit-cut spoof), and optimal-attack games (Helstrom, BB84 = CHSH constant, the 1/2 commit-then-reveal wall, Bužek-Hillery cloner at 5/6)
